title: Key West Ultimate Watersports Adventure with Snorkeling Upgrade
includes: Complimentary beer, wine, soda, water and snacks (alcohol served after all activities are completed)
Nautical restrooms available on the boat
Full Day includes Reef Snorkel - Half Day does not include snorkeling
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Guests born in or after January 1, 1988 who wish to operate a jet ski must obtain a Boater's Safety Certification online for a fee prior to check in.
All guests 18 + must have a government issued photo ID.
All guests under 18 must have an actual parent present with ID to sign waivers.
Credit card with matching ID required at check in
Guests cannot participate if they are under the influence of alcohol, pregnant or age 3 and under.
Guests must be able to speak and understand the English language to operate a jet ski
Guests must be 6 years of age or older in order to parasail or ride the banana boat
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
What makes the Ultimate Adventure H2.0 in Key West truly unique is its all-in-one approach to water fun, combining multiple thrilling activities into one seamless excursion. The Half Day (3.5 hrs) includes parasailing, a Sea-Doo Jet Ski ride, a Banana Boat ride, and access to Key West’s largest certified inflatable Ocean Water Park. Upgrade to the Full Day (6 or 6.5 hrs) for all of those activities, plus a reef snorkeling trip and a light lunch served onboard.

Your adventure begins either on a spacious 65-foot catamaran or our 57-foot motorized catamaran, offering scenic island views and comfort between activities. Enjoy complimentary snacks and unlimited drinks, with beer and wine available after the water fun, and stay protected with reef-safe sunscreen provided. Whether you're a thrill-seeker or just looking to relax and explore, this tour offers a unique way to experience the best of Key West in one unforgettable day.
